explication: Filament is a cross-platform real-time physically based rendering engine. The documented application workflow creates an Engine, Renderer, and SwapChain, configures a View with a Camera and Scene, adds renderable content, and renders frames. Its broader product includes material authoring, glTF asset loading, post-processing, and multiple graphics backends. Edges below rely on README workflow statements or shown JNI/native delegation; unsampled subsystem links are omitted or marked unverified rather than inferred from names.
